description: d_min=0.08 â€” production tail months 50-72 flattens around 3.5-4.5k bbl, declining only ~20% over 22 months, consistent with terminal decline near 8%/yr rather than baseline 5%
outlier_threshold=0.20 â€” sharp dips at months 25 (4862 vs ~7.5k neighbors), 39-40 (2232-2716 vs ~6k), and 58 (1790 vs ~4.6k) are operational shutdowns not captured by current threshold 0.30
d_min=0.07 â€” with b=1.3 from v4, production months 60-72 declines only ~12% (4165 to 3630 bbl over 12 months), suggesting terminal decline closer to 7% than current 5%

qi_guess_strategy=peak_value â€” well ramps from 10.4k to 16.1k bbl in first 4 months, so first-month value (10.4k) underestimates qi; peak_value should anchor initial guess closer to 16k bbl actual peak

significance_threshold=0.35 â€” well peaks at month 4 (16.1k bbl) then immediately declines; lower threshold should detect decline onset earlier, capturing more of the initial steep decline for better curve shape
b_initial=1.0 â€” v4 fitted b=1.3068; starting optimizer closer to fitted value (1.0 vs 0.5) may help convergence find a better local minimum with improved holdout prediction

b_upper_bound=1.5 â€” v4 fitted b=1.3068; reducing upper bound from 2.0 to 1.5 constrains hyperbolic exponent closer to fitted value, preventing optimizer from exploring overly hyperbolic solutions that may overfit training data

outlier_threshold=0.15 â€” despite 0.20 threshold, outlier_rejection_rate remains 0.0%; lowering to 0.15 may finally trigger rejection of operational dips (month 58: 1790 bbl is 61% below neighbors ~4600)

outlier_window=5 â€” window of 3 is too narrow for rolling median to detect single-month dips; window of 5 gives 2 months context on each side, which should flag month 58 (1790 bbl) against median of ~4500 bbl

di_initial=0.80 â€” fitted di=0.38 from starting point 0.5; starting at 0.8 explores higher initial decline rate solutions which may better capture the steep early decline from 16k to 8k bbl in months 4-14

smoothing_window=5 â€” production has significant month-to-month scatter (e.g. months 17-22 swing between 7.2k and 10.7k bbl); wider smoothing should reduce noise and give optimizer cleaner signal for curve fitting
